blocks.title: Online check-in opens - Alaska 316
blocks.detail:
• Check in all 4 in the Alaska app (opens 24 hrs before departure)
• Mobile boarding passes; bag tags printed at the MIA kiosk

blocks.title: Pre-order onboard breakfast (Alaska app)
blocks.detail:
• Pre-order closes before departure - do it this morning
• Popular items sell out on board

blocks.title: Kids' bedtime routine
blocks.detail:
• Lights out 6:00 PM = 10 hrs before the 4:00 AM wake-up
• Bags packed and by the door before bedtime

blocks.title: Wake up & get ready
blocks.detail: • 1 hr to dress, pack the car and load car seats

blocks.title: Drive to MIA - park in Dolphin or Flamingo garage
blocks.detail:
• Early Saturday, light traffic
• Drive time is an estimate from home

blocks.title: Garage → terminal with bags
blocks.detail:
• Garages connect to the terminal by skywalk / MIA Mover
• Extra time for luggage and kids

blocks.title: Alaska check-in & bag drop
blocks.detail:
• Bag drop closes 40 min before departure (7:01 AM)
• Holiday-week Saturday - expect lines

blocks.title: TSA security
blocks.detail:
• 5-8 AM is MIA's peak security window
• 30 min budgeted for a family of four

blocks.title: Buffer - restrooms, water, walk to gate
blocks.detail:
• Fill water bottles after security
• Real breakfast is the pre-ordered onboard meal

blocks.title: At the gate - boarding
blocks.detail:
• Boarding starts about 35-40 min before departure
• Families can pre-board

blocks.title: Alaska 316 - MIA → SEA - nonstop 6h52m
blocks.detail:
• Boeing 737 MAX 9, Economy
• Lands 11:33 AM Pacific (2:33 PM Miami time)
• Breakfast on board (pre-ordered)
blocks.notes: 17,500 Atmos points + $5.60 per person x 4 = 70,000 points + $22.40. Award space seen on seats.aero Oct 18, 2026 (5 seats).
blocks.flag: Not booked yet - award space can disappear.

blocks.title: Breakfast on board
blocks.detail: • Pre-ordered in the Alaska app

blocks.title: Deplane & walk to baggage claim
blocks.detail:
• Families rarely deplane first
• If arriving at an N gate, take the SEA Underground (trains every 3 min)

blocks.title: Baggage claim & restrooms
blocks.detail:
• Domestic arrival, no customs
• Alaska bags usually on the carousel within 20 min

blocks.title: To the Turo meeting spot
blocks.detail:
• Exact spot comes from the host in the Turo app
• Often an off-airport lot by shuttle, or the parking garage

blocks.title: Turo pickup - 8 days
blocks.detail:
• Walk-around photos in the app
• Load luggage, install 2 car seats
• Check tire sidewalls for M+S or snowflake symbol
blocks.notes: Estimate: ~$570 for 8 days, return Dec 27. Confirm whether child seats are included.
blocks.flag: Get written OK from the host to drive into Canada, plus Canada insurance coverage and winter-rated (M+S or snowflake) tires for the Sea-to-Sky.

blocks.title: Drive SEA → Hyatt Regency Seattle
blocks.detail:
• ~14 mi via I-5 to 808 Howell St
• About 25 min on a Saturday midday + buffer

blocks.title: Arrive Hyatt Regency Seattle - park & check in
blocks.detail:
• Hotel garage (no valet)
• Ask for early check-in; bell desk holds bags if the room isn't ready
• Regency Club (8th floor) open to Globalists
blocks.notes: Globalist: breakfast at Andare buffet, Regency Club access, free parking on award stays (otherwise ~$55-65/night). Award rate and room type not set yet.
blocks.flag: Not booked yet. Standard check-in is afternoon - early check-in isn't guaranteed.

blocks.title: Settle in & get ready
blocks.detail:
• Showers, change, unpack basics
• If the room isn't ready: freshen up in the Regency Club

blocks.title: Breakfast - Andare (hotel buffet)
blocks.detail:
• Lobby level, buffet 6:30-11:00 AM
• Globalist breakfast benefit
blocks.notes: Covered by Globalist breakfast. Confirm at check-in how it applies to the kids.

blocks.title: Coats, shoes, out the door
blocks.detail: • Rain jackets - December is Seattle's wettest month

blocks.title: Walk to Pike Place Market
blocks.detail: • 0.6 mi downhill, ~11 min at adult pace

blocks.title: Original Starbucks (1912 Pike Pl)
blocks.detail:
• The 1971 store with the original logo
• Line is usually shortest early in the morning
blocks.notes: Estimate: 2 adult drinks + 2 kids' hot chocolates. This location's own prices aren't posted online.

blocks.title: Pike Place Market walk-through
blocks.detail:
• Pike Place Fish Market - fish tossing at the main arcade
• Rachel the bronze pig, the neon Public Market clock
• Main Arcade stalls and the Down Under lower levels
• Post Alley & the Gum Wall
• Mornings before noon are the least crowded

blocks.title: Walk to Colman Dock (ferry terminal)
blocks.detail:
• Down the Overlook Walk to the waterfront
• 0.7 mi to Pier 52

blocks.title: Ferry terminal - tickets & boarding
blocks.detail:
• Walk-on fare paid in Seattle covers the round trip
• Walk-ons board about 10-15 min before sailing
blocks.notes: 2 adults x $11.35 round trip = $22.70. Ages 18 and under ride free. WSF fare as of Oct 2026.

blocks.title: Ferry to Bainbridge Island
blocks.detail:
• 35-min crossing, skyline views behind you
• Fall/holiday weekend schedule (valid Sep 20-Dec 26)

blocks.title: Walk to Doc's Marina Grill
blocks.detail: • ~0.5 mi through Winslow

blocks.title: Lunch - Doc's Marina Grill
blocks.detail:
• On Eagle Harbor marina
• Burgers, sandwiches, fish & chips, kids' menu
• Open daily 10:45 AM-9:45 PM
blocks.notes: Big Doc Burger $22 + Chicken Cheddar Club $22 (adults) + Kids Chicken Strips $14 + Kids Grilled Cheese $10 (kids) = $68. Entrees only, water. + ~9.2% tax ($6.26) + 20% tip ($13.60) = $87.86. Prices from Doc's online menu, Oct 2026.

blocks.title: Stroll back to the ferry terminal
blocks.detail: • Waterfront Park path along the harbor

blocks.title: Board the return ferry
blocks.detail: • No fare collected on the Bainbridge side for walk-ons

blocks.title: Ferry back to Seattle
blocks.detail: • Best skyline views of the day on the way in

blocks.title: Walk to Pier 57
blocks.detail: • 0.3 mi along the new waterfront promenade

blocks.title: Seattle Great Wheel
blocks.detail:
• 175 ft, out over Elliott Bay
• Timed for sunset (~4:20 PM)
• Light shows run on weekend evenings
blocks.notes: 2 adults x $25 + 2 youth (3-11) x $18 = $86. Online price, Oct 2026; tickets are not date-specific.

blocks.title: Walk back to the hotel
blocks.detail:
• ~1.1 mi, mostly uphill
• A rideshare is ~10 min if the kids are done walking

blocks.title: Quick stop at the hotel
blocks.detail: • Restrooms, dry layers, grab the car

blocks.title: Drive to Ivar's Salmon House
blocks.detail: • ~3 mi to Lake Union's north shore

blocks.title: Dinner - Ivar's Salmon House
blocks.detail:
• Cedar longhouse on Lake Union
• Views of the lake and the downtown skyline lights
• Open Sun 11 AM-8 PM; reserve ahead
blocks.notes: Cedar Plank Sockeye Salmon $44 + Seared Chicken Piccata $36 (adults) + 2x Grilled Cheese w/ fries ~$8.50 (kids) = $97. Entrees only, water. + 10.55% tax ($10.23) + 20% tip ($19.40) = $126.63. Adult prices from the current dinner menu; kids' price read from Ivar's kids menu PDF - treat as approximate.

blocks.title: Bedtime routine
blocks.detail: • Back by 8:00 PM keeps 10 hrs of sleep before the 7:00 AM wake-up

blocks.title: Breakfast - Andare (hotel buffet)
blocks.detail: • Globalist breakfast benefit

blocks.title: Check out & load the car
blocks.detail: • Passports for all 4 in the front-seat bag, not the trunk

blocks.title: Drive Seattle → Canadian border
blocks.detail:
• ~110 mi north on I-5, straight through
• Restroom stop if needed around Burlington or Bellingham
• Before Bellingham, check WSDOT border wait times

blocks.title: Border crossing into Canada
blocks.detail:
• Pacific Highway crossing (exit 275) is often shorter for cars than Peace Arch (exit 276)
• Passports for everyone, including the kids
• Have the Turo rental agreement and host's Canada OK on your phone
• Holiday week - 20-45 min wait budgeted

blocks.title: Drive border → downtown Vancouver
blocks.detail:
• ~33 mi on Highway 99 into downtown (signs in km)
• No winter-tire rule on this stretch

blocks.title: Park near Joe Fortes & walk in
blocks.detail:
• Street parking or a nearby parkade around Robson & Thurlow
• Keep luggage out of sight in the trunk

blocks.title: Lunch - Joe Fortes Seafood & Chop House
blocks.detail:
• Vancouver seafood institution since 1985
• Weekday lunch 11 AM-4 PM
• No kids' menu posted - ask about kids' portions
blocks.notes: Fish & Chips C$32 + Salmon Cakes C$36 (adults) + Chicken & Waffles C$29 + Fish & Chips C$32 (kids, no kids' menu) = C$129. Entrees only, water. + 5% GST (C$6.45) + 20% tip (C$25.80) = C$161.25, about US$116 at ~0.72. Prices from the May 2026 lunch menu; kids' portions, if offered, would lower this.

blocks.title: Back to the car & drive to the hotel
blocks.detail: • A few blocks to 655 Burrard St

blocks.title: Hyatt Regency Vancouver - valet, check in & relax
blocks.detail:
• Valet the car and luggage
• Early check-in requested (Globalist)
• Up to the room to unpack and rest
blocks.notes: Globalist benefits apply. Award rate, room type, number of nights and parking cost not set yet.
blocks.flag: Not booked yet. Early check-in isn't guaranteed.
